root_cause.text: The vulnerability arises from an incorrect condition in the `mtype_del` function of the netfilter ipset subsystem that fails to identify and release logically empty hash buckets when the position index `n->pos` is non-zero despite all underlying slots being unused.
root_cause.evidence: The patch updates the check in `ip_set_hash_gen.h` from `if (n->pos == 0 && k == 0)` to `if (k == n->pos)`, fixing the issue described in the CVE where buckets were missed when "live entries have all been removed while n->pos still points past deleted slots."

vuln_statements.explanation: The loop starting at line 1097 begins from variable i (which equals n->pos) rather than 0, potentially missing unused slots when i > 0. This causes the condition to fail to count all unused slots correctly against n->pos, preventing proper detection and release of logically empty hash buckets when n->pos is non-zero despite all underlying slots being unused.
